evidence.title: Attention Is All You Need · arXivisual

name: arXivisual
summary: Turns any arXiv paper into an interactive scrollytelling explainer with AI-generated animations.
description: Paste an arXiv URL or ID and the site generates an interactive scrollytelling breakdown of the paper, section by section. An explore page lists papers that have already been visualized, and any paper can be opened directly by adding "isual" to the arxiv.org hostname (arxiv.org/abs/… becomes arxivisual.org/abs/…).
contains: turns any arXiv URL or ID into a visual, narrated breakdown
AI-generated Manim animations, section by section
library of already visualized papers to browse
add 'isual' to an arxiv.org link to open the visualized version
